Usage: ptai-mcp [options] [command]

Standalone CLI launcher for PT Application Inspector MCP proxy

Options:
  -V, --version   output the version number
  -h, --help      display help for command

Commands:
  start           Start the MCP proxy
  install         Download and install the analyzer bundle
  configure       Configure MCP servers and hooks for supported agents
  update          Update the analyzer bundle without prompting
  status          Show bundle and agent configuration status
  uninstall       Remove the analyzer bundle and agent configuration
  help [command]  display help for command
